Master Data Management

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve operational efficiency through data standardization and automation.

• Support enterprise initiatives involving AI, advanced analytics, customer engagement, and commercial transformation.

• Build commercial data quality standards, KPIs, and monitoring processes, and run them on an ongoing basis.

• Develop scorecards and reporting that provide visibility into data health across commercial domains.

• Perform root-cause analysis and execute remediation for recurring data quality issues - writing the fixes, not just assigning them.

• Partner with business stakeholders to prioritize and resolve data-related risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that measurably increase trust in commercial data assets.

Commercial Data Operations & Business Enablement

• Write and maintain operational support processes, documentation, SOPs, data dictionaries, and process maps to improve platform sustainability and supportability.

• Translate business requirements into working technical solutions, and build the datasets, validations, and outputs directly; support user training, documentation, and adoption efforts.

• Deliver and validate high-quality commercial master data provisioning across Account Planning, CRM, Customer Master, Business Intelligence, and Commercial Analytics platforms, ensuring data consistency, governance, and alignment with business requirements.

• Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements, workflow automation

title: Motion Designer, Growth
description:
About Replika

Ten years ago, we built the world’s first AI companion - before LLMs, before ChatGPT, and before anyone knew what AI could be.
What started as a way to patch a hole in our hearts became something unexpected: a catalyst. Millions of people told us Replika helped them reconnect with the world. They texted that old friend. They picked up that forgotten hobby. They took that walk around town. While today’s tech keeps people scrolling, we discovered AIs can push us outward, if we let them.
Now we’re being reborn with a new vision: the first AI with heart, for making the most out of life. Gentle nudges to meet friends when you’re feeling shy. Ideas for exploring new places when it’s easier to stay home. Daily conversation about whatever moves you - ballet, philosophy, aliens, or gossip - at 2am when no one else is awake. We’re not building an AI to validate or pacify. We’re building something modeled after the relationships that transform us. Someone who asks the right questions at the right time. Someone who helps you look inward, and pushes you outward. We’ve been featured in TED Talks, Stanford and Harvard studies, the Lex Fridman podcast, because 40M+ people connect with Replika in a deeply human way. And we’re just getting started.
About the role
Replika is growing fast, and paid social is one of the biggest drivers of that growth. The ads people see on TikTok, Meta, and YouTube are often their first impression of Replika - and this role owns the motion behind them.
You’ll design and animate video ads and UGC creatives for our paid campaigns, working on a small growth team alongside producers and user acquisition managers. You’ll take a concept, turn it into a finished ad, put it live, and iterate based on how it performs - treating channel data and results as creative input, not an afterthought. It’s fast-paced and high-volume, and you own the craft from idea to final cut.
The goal is simple: creative that stops the scroll, gets people to try Replika , and looks and feels like Replika while doing it.
What You'll Be Doing

• Concept and animate video ads and UGC creatives for paid social - from first idea to finished, ready-to-run ad - for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and wherever attention moves next.

• Bring your own concepts and hooks to the table - spot fresh angles, pitch them, and turn the best ones into ads worth testing.

• Explore a range of creative styles - from polished motion to raw, native-feeling UGC - to find what breaks through.

• Produce a steady stream of new creative and variations at the pace paid social demands, without dropping quality.

• Work with producers and UAMs, and keep an eye on what’s working across the market, to turn briefs into winners - and winners into more winners.

• Create and maintain an appealing, consistent Replika presence across social media.

• Own the motion craft of our paid creative end-to-end: set the bar, ship fast, and keep raising it.

What We're Looking For

• A strong motion design portfolio (a portfolio of ad creatives that performed in real paid campaigns is a plus).

• Hands-on mastery of After Effects, Figma, and the rest of the Adobe Creative Suite - plus whatever visual editing tools get the job done.

• Good taste and a strong eye for composition, colour, and easing - the details that make motion polished and pleasant to watch.

• A feel for ad structure - hook, emotion, CTA - and the pacing and timing that hold attention in the first few seconds.

• A knack for making stop-scrollers that still make Replika look and feel on brand.

• You actively use AI models across your work - image, video, and sound - and know how to weave them into your workflow to get the best possible results out of generated media.

• A real interest in the product and the people who use it.

• You’re fast and self-directed. You ship, you learn, you tighten. No hand-holding.

• Excellent communication skills in English (C1 or higher preferred).

Bonus Points

• Comfort with vibe-co

title: AI Researcher — Inference Optimization
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking an AI Researcher with deep experience in inference optimization to design, evaluate, and deploy high-performance inference systems for large-scale machine learning models. You will work at the intersection of model architecture, systems engineering, and hardware-aware optimization , improving latency, throughput, and cost efficiency across real-world production environments.
Key Responsibilities

• Research and develop techniques to optimize inference performance for large neural networks.

• Improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and cost per inference .

• Design and evaluate model-level optimizations (quantization, pruning, KV-cache optimization, architecture-aware simplifications).

• Implement systems-level optimizations (dynamic batching, kernel fusion, multi-GPU inference, prefill vs decode optimization).

• Benchmark inference workloads across hardware accelerators.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy optimized inference pipelines .

• Translate research insights into production-ready improvements .

Required Qualifications

• Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, or AI systems .

• Hands-on experience optimizing inference for large-scale models .

• Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch).

• Experience with inference tooling (e.g., Triton, TensorRT, vLLM, ONNX Runtime).

• Ability to design experiments and communicate results clearly.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Experience deploying production inference systems at scale .

• Familiarity with distributed and multi-GPU inference .

• Experience contributing to open-source ML or inference frameworks .

• Authorship or co-authorship of peer-reviewed research papers in machine learning, systems, or related fields.

• Experience working close to hardware (CUDA, ROCm, profiling tools).

What Success Looks Like

• Measurable gains in latency, throughput, and cost efficiency .

• Optimized inference systems running reliably in production.

• Research ideas successfully translated into deployable systems.

• Clear benchmarks and documentation that inform product decisions.

Relevant Research Areas (Bonus)

• Long-context inference optimization

• Speculative decoding

• KV-cache compression and paging

• Efficient decoding strategies

• Hardware-aware inference design

The US Tax Compliance Manager will be responsible for overseeing the timely and accurate completion of U.S. tax compliance engagements for individuals, corporations, partnerships, trusts and estates. The role will provide technical review and guidance to the tax team, research complex compliance matters, monitor changes in U.S. tax legislation and help ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across the U.S. tax practice.

• Prepare and review U.S. tax returns and related information reporting, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1065, 1041, 5471, 5472, 8858, 8865 and other applicable filings.

title: Mapping and Analysis of Family Language in African Union Agreed Language and Hum
description:
1. Background
Fòs Feminista . Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. In 2026, Fòs Feminista completed a three-decade mapping of how "family" has been used in United Nations agreed language - reviewing 1,441 excerpts across 180 UN documents from 1994 to 2025. That mapping found that a substantial, underused body of UN agreed language already centers individual rights, gender equality, and diverse family forms, offering feminist advocates a propositional foundation to build on rather than only a defensive posture against anti-rights mobilization around "family."
This mapping has not yet been extended to the regional level. The African Union (AU) has its own distinct body of human rights instruments, agreed language, and political dynamics relevant to family, gender equality, and SRHR - including the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (the Maputo Protocol), one of the most progressive regional instruments globally on women’s rights, alongside AU mechanisms with an active record on ending child marriage and other harmful practices. At the same time, the AU is not insulated from anti-rights and anti-gender actors seeking to co-opt family language in multilateral outcomes.
As such, Fòs Feminista is seeking a consultant to conduct a systematic mapping and analysis of family-related language across African Union agreed language and human rights mechanisms to produce a rigorous, regionally grounded evidence base for use in African Union-level advocacy.
2. Purpose and Objectives
The purpose of this consultancy is to produce a systematic, evidence-based mapping of how "family" is defined, referenced, and used across African Union agreed language, in order to:

• Identify where existing AU agreed language already reflects rights-based, gender-equal, and diverse understandings of family, distinguishing this from areas where family language is used restrictively or left unaddressed.

• Produce a citable evidence base to inform feminist advocacy in African Union-level negotiations.

• Identify patterns specific to the African regional context - including but not limited to child marriage, female genital mutilation and other harmful practices, inheritance and marital property rights, and care - grounded in the region’s own instruments and mechanisms.

• Analyze whether language has changed over time, assessing whether it reflects advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and identifying the instruments, sessions or political context associated with such shifts.

• Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for use in AU Summit declarations, Specialized Technical Committee outcomes, and other AU negotiating processes.

3. Scope of Work
The consultant will review family-related language across the following African Union instruments and mechanisms, at minimum:

• The African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights (1981) and its jurisprudence.

• The Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (Maputo Protocol, 2003), with particular attention to its marriage, family, and inheritance provisions.

• The African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (1990).

• Decisions, declarations, and resolutions of the AU Assembly of Heads of State and Government and the Executive Council.

• Resolutions, General Comments, and Concluding Observations of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR).

• General Comments and Concluding Observations of the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (ACERWC).

Missions and activities of the position

1. Project phase - owner's engineer for Maintenance

• Represent Maintenance in every phase of new equipment projects (starting with the MRS1 cross-belt sorter), from design reviews to FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up. For the sorter, whose design is already set, take over the installed system and optimise it after go-live.

• Work side by side with the OEM / integrator engineers: collect technical knowledge, challenge design choices, maintainability, access, spare-part strategy and the proposed maintenance plan before they are frozen.

• Define and verify the Maintenance acceptance criteria (documentation, training, spare parts, safety, availability targets). The Maintenance sign-off is mandatory: no handover to operations without it.

• Track and drive to closure the technical punch list and warranty issues raised during commissioning and the warranty period.

2. Technical file & spare parts

• Build and own the equipment technical file: as-built electrical and mechanical drawings, PLC and software versions, parameter backups, network architecture, safety documentation, OEM manuals.

• Create the asset hierarchy and criticality analysis in the CMMS.

• Define the critical spare-parts list (references, min/max stock, lead times) and keep it up to date.

• Reduce dependency on the OEM: identify and qualify second-source suppliers for critical parts, run compatibility tests and document equivalences.

• Propose spare-parts and supplier decisions to the Maintenance Manager; after an initial period, take these decisions autonomously within agreed limits, with the Maintenance Manager's validation.

3. Maintenance strategy & procedures

• Write and maintain preventive maintenance plans, corrective procedures and troubleshooting guides for the equipment family, based on OEM data, FMEA and field experience.

• Monitor equipment performance (availability, MTBF, MTTR, top failure modes), lead root-cause analysis on recurring or major failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

• Challenge the original design when needed and drive engineering changes: retrofits, drive and firmware updates, software or parameter optimisation, with the OEM and internal stakeholders.

4. Training & technical support

• Train the operational maintenance team (technicians and operatives) on the equipment, its software/HMI and the troubleshooting procedures; validate their autonomy level.

• Act as the level-2 / level-3 technical expert for the equipment family on site and remotely

• Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.

• 8+ years of product design experience with 2+ years of management experience

• Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support senior designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user centered craft.

• Experience building and scaling design systems.

• AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.

• Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces
